subject: a stocky German composer of the early 1800s with a broad strong face, heavy brows, intense eyes and thick untidy dark hair, wearing a dark wool tailcoat with a high collar, a loosely tied white cravat and a plain waistcoat

panels.01-bonn: a small boy of seven in an 18th-century boy's coat and buckled shoes seated at a harpsichord in a candlelit Rhineland townhouse room in Bonn, 1778, his feet not reaching the floor, a stern father in a powdered wig standing over him with a hand on the music stand, warm lamplight, the old town and church spire through the window
panels.02-organ: a 12-year-old boy with dark unruly hair in a plain 1780s coat and white stockings, sitting on a wooden bench at the keyboard of a large church pipe organ in Bonn, tall wooden organ case with rows of tin pipes above him, an older organist in a black coat standing beside him and pointing at the music, candlelit stone church, only two people
panels.03-vienna: a young man of twenty-one in a travelling coat and tricorn hat stepping down from a horse-drawn coach on a cobbled Vienna street in November 1792, a small trunk and a bundle of music under his arm, baroque palaces and the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral behind, autumn light, hopeful
panels.04-heiligenstadt: a young {S} walking alone along a path between vineyards and wooded hills above the village of Heiligenstadt near Vienna in summer 1802, stopping to write music in a small pocket sketchbook with a pencil, a far-off shepherd on the hillside, wind in the grass, thoughtful and determined
panels.05-sketches: {S} at work at a square wooden fortepiano in a cluttered Vienna apartment in 1808, leaning over the keys with one ear close to the instrument, pages of manuscript music covered in crossed-out notes scattered across the piano lid, the floor and a chair, a quill and ink pot, an uneaten meal pushed aside, late afternoon light
panels.06-conversation: an older {S} with greying hair seated at a table in a Vienna coffee house in 1818, reading what a friend has just written in a small open notebook, the friend holding a pencil and waiting, other guests chatting in the background, warm and companionable
panels.07-ninth: a grand Vienna theatre in 1824 at the end of a concert, an orchestra and a large choir on stage, an older {S} with grey hair standing near the conductor facing the musicians, a young woman singer in an 1820s gown gently turning him by the arm to face the hall, the audience on its feet waving hats and handkerchiefs, golden stage light, triumphant and moving
panels.08-quartets: an old {S} with grey hair at a writing desk by candlelight in a quiet country house in winter 1826, writing a string quartet score with a quill, a brass ear trumpet lying beside the papers, a violin and cello resting against the wall, frost on the window, calm deep concentration
